description: Map the reviewer's display name from source. Use 'Anonymous' when the reviewer opted out of sharing a name.
Map the reviewer's self-reported location (city, region, or country).
Map the display name of the brand responder. Required when brand_response_text is supplied.

Map the brand response publish date. Accepts ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.fraction][Z|±HH:MM] or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss[.fraction]; two-digit hour/minute/second, e.g. 2024-06-18T09:15:00Z or 2024-06-18 09:15:00). Stored as the calendar date only (any time portion is discarded). Required when brand_response_text is supplied.
Map the official brand response to this review from source.
example_format: Thanks Jane — glad the London Dry is working for your martinis.

description: Map reviewer-supplied negatives, separate from review_text. Enter multiple values pipe-separated (|).
Map the count of helpful votes from source (integer ≥ 0).
Map whether this review row is active. Inactive rows are excluded from display.
Map whether the reviewer received a sample, discount, or other incentive. Must be TRUE when compensation occurred.
Map whether the reviewer would recommend the product to others.
Map whether this review was syndicated from a retailer or partner site rather than collected directly.
Map whether the reviewer's purchase was verified (e.g. order match). TRUE enables a 'Verified purchase' badge.
Map the product item_id this review belongs to. Used to associate the review with a product when displaying ratings and aggregated review data.
Map the review content locale in IETF form (language_REGION), e.g. en_US, en_GB, fr_FR.
Map the caption for the first review image.
example_format: My home bar setup with the bottle

description: Map the HTTPS URL of the first image attached to this review.
Map the caption for the second review image.
Map the HTTPS URL of the second image attached to this review.
Map the caption for the third review image.
Map the HTTPS URL of the third image attached to this review.
Map the canonical product page URL where this review was originally collected (attribution for syndicated content).
Map reviewer-supplied positives, separate from review_text. Enter multiple values pipe-separated (|).
Map this reviewer's star rating from source. Integer values from 1 to 5 inclusive (e.g. 4 or 5); values outside that range are rejected.
Map the unique review identifier from source. Stable upsert key on re-upload — re-supplying the same review_id replaces the prior record.
Map short keywords describing what the review covers, as pipe-separated tags. Contributes to review search and aggregate filter-by-tag when the Product Reviews tool is enabled.
Map the review body from source. Prefer plain text without HTML markup; stored and displayed as provided.
example_format: Smooth on the rocks, perfect for a martini. Aroma is bright, finish is clean.

description: Map the short review headline from source (typically 3–10 words).
Map the label of the first secondary rating dimension (Title Case), e.g. Aroma, Quality, Fit.
Map the maximum value of the first secondary rating scale (required with label and value).
Map the value of the first secondary rating on its native scale.
Map the label of the second secondary rating dimension.
Map the maximum value of the second secondary rating scale.
Map the value of the second secondary rating dimension.
Map the label of the third secondary rating dimension.
Map the maximum value of the third secondary rating scale.
Map the value of the third secondary rating dimension.

Map the review submission date from source. Accepts ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.fraction][Z|±HH:MM] or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss[.fraction]; two-digit hour/minute/second, e.g. 2024-06-15T14:30:00Z or 2024-06-15 14:30:00). Stored as the calendar date only (any time portion is discarded).
Map the retailer or partner name where the review was originally collected, when is_syndicated is TRUE.
